references.note: third-party BGA wiki card page; re-checked 2026-11-24 (page rev. 2024/10/10). Confirmed: no cost (コスト: ー), prerequisite 3 occupations (条件: 職業3), points 1 (勝利点: 1), effect = 'このカードは全員が使えるアクションスペースとなる。使ったプレイヤーはすでにストックにある種類の建築資材を1つずつ得る。ほかのプレイヤーが使うときは、まずあなたに食料1を渡さなければならない。' (this card is an action space usable by everyone; the user gets 1 building resource of each type already in stock; another player using it must first pay the owner 1 food).

English list page row re-checked 2026-11-24 (list rev. 2026/06/12). Confirmed effect text: 'This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 1 building resource of each type they already have. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 food.'

effects.notes: The player who uses this card gets 1 building resource of each type they already have in stock.
If another player uses this card, they must first pay 1 food to the card owner. Enforcement when the user cannot pay is undecided (BQ-13).

unresolved_fields: effects: no established modeling for a card acting as a universal action space usable by every player (not a farmyard space). Source rule text confirmed by JA p=2672 + EN list on the 2026-11-24 re-check; encoding is a design question.

effects.1: source confirms non-owner users 'must first pay you 1 food' (mandatory payment, no waiver stated), but neither JA nor EN states what happens when the user cannot pay — use illegal or payment waived is undecided (BQ-13).
